newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - BRAZIL'S CPFL MAINTAINED.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BRAZIL'S CPFL MAINTAINED.

text.p: ING Barings said Tuesday it has reaffirmed its buy rating on preferred shares of Brazilian state-owned power firm Cia Paulista de Forca e Luz (CPFL) and its hold rating on its common shares.

-- ING Barings analyst Charles Barnett, citing CPFL's second-half results, said in a report he also raised 1997-1999 earnings estimates for the firm and increased his price target to 265 reais ($229) per 1,000 shares from 248 reais ($214).

-- Barnett said CPFL's second-quarter net profit of 37 million reais ($34 million) or 1.89 reais ($1.75) was in line with forecasts if one strips out a non-recurring expenses of 0.35 reais per share. He raised EPS estimates to $9.48 from $9.08 for 1997 and to $12.40 from $10.80 for 1998 and set a 1999 EPS estimate at $15.60.
-- The Sao Paulo state owned firm plans to cut personnel by another nine percent to 5,800 employees, a figure expected to fall further under private management, he added.
-- CPFL was likely to be privatized by the end of the year, Barnett said.
-- Its preferred share was untraded Tuesday after closing Monday at 186.50 reais while its common was up 1.05 percent at 211.20 reais at 1135 local/1435 GMT in Sao Paulo.
